Read the file first — it was modified in Phase 1 (jade green is gone, ComfyUI native palette is in place).

**Task C5: Expand spacing tokens and message gaps**

Add new spacing tokens to the `:root` block (after the existing spacing section):
```css
  --sd-space-2xl: 24px;
  --sd-space-3xl: 32px;
  --sd-msg-gap: 20px;
  --sd-para-gap: 12px;
```

Update `.sd-messages`:
- `padding: var(--sd-space-lg)` → `padding: var(--sd-space-xl) var(--sd-space-lg)`
- `gap: var(--sd-space-md)` → `gap: var(--sd-msg-gap)`

**Task C6: Improve message bubble readability**

Update `.sd-message`:
- `gap: 2px` → `gap: var(--sd-space-sm)`
- `padding: var(--sd-space-md) 10px` → `padding: var(--sd-space-lg) var(--sd-space-xl)`
- `line-height: 1.5` → `line-height: 1.7`
- `font-size: 12px` → `font-size: 13px`
- `border-radius: 6px` → `border-radius: 8px`

Update `.sd-message__label`:
- Add `margin-bottom: 2px;`
- `font-size: 10px` → `font-size: 10.5px`

Update `.sd-text-body`:
- `font-size: 12px` → `font-size: 13px`
- `line-height: 1.5` → `line-height: 1.7`

Update `.sd-text-body p`:
- `margin: 0 0 var(--sd-space-md) 0` → `margin: 0 0 var(--sd-para-gap) 0`

Update `.sd-code-block`:
- `font-size: 11px` → `font-size: 11.5px`
- `line-height: 1.5` → `line-height: 1.65`
- `padding: var(--sd-space-md) var(--sd-space-lg)` → `padding: var(--sd-space-lg) var(--sd-space-xl)`
- `margin: var(--sd-space-md) 0` → `margin: var(--sd-space-lg) 0`

Update `.sd-code-inline`:
- `padding: 1px 5px` → `padding: 2px 7px`

**Task C7: Add visual message separators and soften user bubbles**

Add these new rules after the `.sd-message--system .sd-message__body` rule:

```css
/* Visual breathing line between consecutive agent messages */
.sd-message--agent + .sd-message--agent {
  padding-top: var(--sd-space-xl);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--sd-border-subtle);
  margin-top: var(--sd-space-xs);
}
```

Update the existing `.sd-message--user` rule — ADD (don't replace existing properties):
- `border: 1px solid var(--sd-border-subtle);`

Update the existing `.sd-message--agent` rule — ADD:
- `border-left: 2px solid var(--sd-accent-dim);`

Update `.sd-input-bar`:
- `padding: 10px var(--sd-space-lg)` → `padding: var(--sd-space-lg) var(--sd-space-xl)`

Make ALL changes.
